item.title: Egyptian archaeologists uncover 3 tombs, 5 mummies, and Roman remains
item.description: An Egyptian archaeological mission has uncovered three tombs at the Sheikh Sobi site. These burials include mummies and sarcophagi from the Late and Roman periods. These discoveries offer insights into the Bahariya Oasis's ancient communities. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Morocco is testing a 'sponge' pavement that stays 16°F cooler by itself, aims at replacing black asphalt
item.description: Morocco is pioneering a novel sponge pavement designed to enhance water management and mitigate heat effects. Unlike conventional black asphalt, this innovative surface enables water to seep through, promoting natural cooling through evaporation when moisture exists. This initiative aims to bolster urban climate resilience and elevate the comfort of residents, with pilot projects underway in Marrakech and Agadir as part of a larger sustainable city initiative. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
